definitions.explanation: intense surprise or shock at something unexpected

examples.japanese: {驚愕|きょうがく}の{事実|じじつ}が{明|あき}らかになった。
examples.english: An astonishing fact came to light.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{告白|こくはく}に{驚愕|きょうがく}した。
examples.english: I was astonished by his confession.

examples.japanese: {驚愕|きょうがく}のあまり{言葉|ことば}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: I was so astonished that I lost my words.

notes:
VERB FORM:
{驚愕|きょうがく}する - to be astonished

COMMON USES:
- {驚愕|きょうがく}の{事実|じじつ} - astonishing fact
- {驚愕|きょうがく}の{結末|けつまつ} - shocking ending
- {驚愕|きょうがく}の{展開|てんかい} - astonishing development

INTENSITY:
{驚愕|きょうがく} is stronger than {驚|おどろ}き (surprise) and is often used in written language or dramatic contexts.

RELATED:
- {愕然|がくぜん}とする - to be dumbfounded
- {仰天|ぎょうてん}する - to be astounded
- {驚嘆|きょうたん}する - to marvel at
